config/settings_data.json: Your theme editor settings, such as colors, fonts, and section content.
config/settings_schema.json: The list of settings available in the theme editor.
templates/*.json: Page layouts and section content you set up in the theme editor.
templates/customers/*.json: Page layouts and section content you set up in the theme editor.
sections/*.json: Header and footer content you set up in the theme editor.
layout/*.liquid: The master layout used by every page of your store.
locales/*.json: Your store's text and translations, including edits made with 'Edit default theme content'.
